blocks.text: enough va too: yetarli va ortiqcha

**enough** — kerakli miqdorda, «yetarli, yetarlicha». **too** — kerakli yoki maqbul miqdordan ko'p, «haddan tashqari, ortiqcha». Asoslari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 91–92-darslar). Bu darsda e'tibor uchta nozik joyga: **enough** ning gapdagi o'rni, **too / enough + for somebody + to do** qolipi va gap oxirida to'ldiruvchining **takrorlanmasligi** (too hot to drink). O'zbekchada «yetarlicha» doim sifatdan **oldin** keladi — «yetarlicha katta». Inglizchada esa sifatdan **keyin**: big **enough**. «enough big» — o'zbeklarning eng ko'p uchraydigan xatosi.

Sifat va ravishdan **keyin**: Is the room **big enough**? We didn't leave **early enough**. Otdan **oldin**: We haven't got **enough time**. **enough** yolg'iz ham keladi: I've had **enough** (yetadi, to'ydim). **enough of** faqat aniqlovchi so'z yoki olmoshdan oldin ishlatiladi — the, my, this, them, us: Have you had **enough of** the cake? There weren't **enough of** us. «enough of money» — xato, chunki money dan oldin aniqlovchi yo'q. **I've had enough of ...** — «... jonimga tegdi» ma'nosida ham keladi.

items.text: The bed isn't **long enough** for someone as tall as Oliver.
items.translation: Karavot Oliverdek baland bo'yli odam uchun **yetarlicha uzun** emas.

items.text: We haven't got **enough** plates for all the guests.
I've had **enough of** his excuses — he's late every single day.
items.translation: Uning bahonalari **jonimga tegdi** — har kuni kechikadi.

blocks.text: too + sifat / ravish; too much / too many

**too** sifat yoki ravishdan oldin keladi: **too** hot, **too** slowly. Ot bilan: **too much** + sanalmaydigan (too much sugar), **too many** + sanaladigan (too many cars); aksi — **too little / too few** (much, many, little, few → 87-dars). Kuchaytirish uchun **much too, far too**, yumshatish uchun **a bit too**: **much too** expensive («too much expensive» — xato), **far too many** people. **too** va **very** farqi: **very** — shunchaki «juda», muammo yo'q: It's **very** hot, but I love it. **too** — «haddan oshgan», natijada nimadir bo'lmaydi: It's **too** hot — we can't sit outside.

items.text: These shoes are **far too** expensive for a teenager.
items.translation: Bu tuflilar o'smir uchun **haddan tashqari** qimmat.

items.text: There's **too much** salt in this salad — I can't eat it.
items.translation: Bu salatda tuz **haddan ziyod** — yeya olmayman.

items.text: It's **very** cold today, but the sun is shining, so let's go for a walk.
items.translation: Bugun havo **juda** sovuq, lekin quyosh charaqlab turibdi — sayrga chiqaylik.

blocks.text: **too** va **enough** dan keyin ko'pincha **to + fe'l** keladi — nima uchun yetarli yoki ortiqcha ekanini aytadi: He's **old enough to drive**. It's **too late to call** her. Harakatni kim bajarishini ko'rsatish kerak bo'lsa, **for + kimdir** qo'shiladi: The box is **too heavy for me to lift**. The text is **easy enough for children to read**. O'zbekchada: «... uchun yetarlicha ...», «... uchun juda ...», «... ga kuchi / yoshi yetmaydi». «too heavy for lift» — xato: **for** dan keyin kishi, keyin **to + fe'l**. Sifat + to qolipining boshqa holatlari (easy to understand, nice of you to ...) → 65-dars.

items.text: Is your son **tall enough to** go on this ride?
The museum is **too far for us to** walk — let's take a taxi.
items.translation: Muzey biz piyoda borishimiz uchun **juda uzoq** — taksiga o'tiraylik.

items.text: There isn't **enough** light **for** me **to** read in here.

blocks.text: too hot to drink — to'ldiruvchi takrorlanmaydi

Agar gapning egasi fe'lning to'ldiruvchisi ham bo'lsa, gap oxirida **it / them** qo'yilmaydi: The coffee is **too hot to drink** («to drink it» — xato), chunki ichiladigan narsa — coffee, u allaqachon gap boshida bor. This bag is **too heavy for me to carry**. The film was **good enough to watch** twice. O'zbekchada ham shunday: «Qahva ichish uchun juda issiq» — «uni» qo'shilmaydi. Lekin **It** bilan boshlangan gapda to'ldiruvchi kerak: It's too hot **to drink the coffee**.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «enough big» → **big enough**; «enough of money» → **enough money**; «too much expensive» → **much too** / **far too** expensive; «too much people» → **too many** people; «It's very heavy to carry» (ko'tarib bo'lmaydi demoqchi) → **too heavy** to carry; «too heavy for carry» → too heavy **to** carry; «too heavy for me to carry **it**» → it ortiqcha.

Eslab qolish: **enough** sifatga **orqadan** yopishadi (big **enough**), otga esa **oldidan** (**enough** time). **too** har doim **muammo**ni bildiradi — gapga «shuning uchun ... bo'lmaydi» qo'shib ko'ring: It's too hot (shuning uchun ichib bo'lmaydi). Ma'no buzilsa — very kerak.

rows: **too much / too many / too few / too little**
**old enough to** vote, **too late to** call

examples.title: Adjective / adverb + **enough**: **big enough**
examples.description: enough sifat yoki ravishdan keyin keladi: big enough, early enough. «enough big» — xato.

sentences.text: Is the hall **big enough** for two hundred guests?
sentences.translation: Zal ikki yuz mehmon uchun **yetarlicha kattami**?

sentences.text: My English isn't **good enough** for this job yet.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilim bu ish uchun hali **yetarli darajada yaxshi** emas.

sentences.text: Bekzod ran as fast as he could, but it wasn't **fast enough**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bor kuchi bilan yugurdi, lekin bu **yetarlicha tez** emas edi.

sentences.text: Is the room **warm enough** for you, or shall I turn the heating up?
sentences.translation: Xona sizga **yetarlicha iliqmi** yoki isitishni kuchaytiraymi?

sentences.text: Be careful — the ice on the lake isn't **thick enough** yet.
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'ling — ko'ldagi muz hali **yetarlicha qalin** emas.

sentences.text: We didn't leave **early enough**, and we got stuck in traffic.
sentences.translation: Uydan **yetarlicha erta** chiqmadik va tirbandlikka tushib qoldik.

sentences.text: The flat is nice, but it isn't **close enough** to the city centre.
sentences.translation: Kvartira yaxshi, lekin shahar markaziga **yetarlicha yaqin** emas.

sentences.text: Is a salary of two thousand pounds **high enough** in London?
sentences.translation: Londonda ikki ming funt maosh **yetarlimi**?

sentences.text: Nilufar speaks **clearly enough**, but she needs to slow down a bit.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **yetarlicha aniq** gapiradi, lekin biroz sekinroq gapirishi kerak.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the photos aren't **sharp enough** to print.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, suratlar chop etish uchun **yetarlicha tiniq** emas.

examples.title: **enough** + noun; **enough of** us / the cake
examples.description: enough otdan oldin: enough seats, enough information. enough of — faqat the / my / this / us / them dan oldin.

sentences.text: Are there **enough** seats on the bus for the whole group?
sentences.translation: Avtobusda butun guruh uchun **yetarli** o'rindiq bormi?

sentences.text: Most teenagers don't get **enough** exercise these days.
sentences.translation: Hozir ko'pchilik o'smirlar **yetarlicha** jismoniy mashq qilmaydi.

sentences.text: There isn't **enough** information in the report to make a decision.
sentences.translation: Hisobotda qaror qabul qilish uchun **yetarli** ma'lumot yo'q.

sentences.text: We've got **enough** food for a week, so don't worry.
sentences.translation: Bir haftaga **yetadigan** ovqatimiz bor, xavotir olmang.

sentences.text: Have you had **enough** to eat, or would you like some more?
sentences.translation: **Yetarlicha yedingizmi** yoki yana solib beraymi?

sentences.text: I've had **enough of** this job — I'm going to look for something else.
sentences.translation: Bu ish **jonimga tegdi** — boshqa narsa qidiraman.

sentences.text: There weren't **enough of** us to play a proper football match.
sentences.translation: To'liq futbol o'ynashga **sonimiz yetmasdi**.

sentences.text: Is there **enough** time to grab a sandwich before the meeting?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishdan oldin buterbrod yeb olishga **vaqt yetadimi**?

sentences.text: Not **enough** students signed up, so the course was cancelled.
sentences.translation: **Yetarlicha** talaba yozilmadi, shuning uchun kurs bekor qilindi.

sentences.text: Have you saved **enough** money for the trip to Japan?
sentences.translation: Yaponiyaga sayohat uchun **yetarli** pul yig'dingmi?

examples.title: **too** + adjective / adverb: **much too**, **far too**
examples.description: too — haddan oshgan, muammo bor. Kuchaytirish: much too, far too; yumshatish: a bit too.

sentences.text: This jacket is **too** small for me — have you got it in a large?
sentences.translation: Bu kurtka menga **kichiklik qiladi** — kattarog'i bormi?

sentences.text: Slow down, please — you're driving **too** fast for these narrow streets.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, sekinroq — bu tor ko'chalar uchun **haddan tashqari** tez haydayapsiz.

sentences.text: The flat was nice, but it was **much too** expensive for us.
sentences.translation: Kvartira yaxshi edi, lekin biz uchun **haddan ziyod** qimmat edi.

sentences.text: Don't go out without a coat — it's **far too** cold.
sentences.translation: Paltosiz chiqma — havo **haddan tashqari** sovuq.

sentences.text: The music in the restaurant was **a bit too** loud for a conversation.
sentences.translation: Restorandagi musiqa suhbat uchun **biroz balandlik qilardi**.

sentences.text: Aziz is **too** honest — he always says exactly what he thinks.
sentences.translation: Aziz **haddan ortiq** to'g'riso'z — doim nima o'ylasa, shuni aytadi.

sentences.text: We arrived **too** late, and the museum had already closed.
sentences.translation: Biz **kechikib qoldik** — muzey allaqachon yopilgan edi.

sentences.text: Your essay is **too** long — the limit is five hundred words.
sentences.translation: Inshongiz **haddan tashqari** uzun — chegara besh yuz so'z.

sentences.text: Is the soup **too** salty? — No, it's just right.
sentences.translation: Sho'rva **sho'r bo'lib ketdimi**? — Yo'q, xuddi o'zi.

sentences.text: The instructions were **far too** complicated, so I asked my son for help.
sentences.translation: Yo'riqnoma **haddan tashqari** murakkab edi, shuning uchun o'g'limdan yordam so'radim.

examples.title: **too much**, **too many**, **too little**, **too few**
examples.description: too much + sanalmaydigan, too many + sanaladigan ot; aksi — too little / too few. Kuchaytirish: far too many.

sentences.text: I ate **too much** at dinner, and now I feel sick.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatda **ortiqcha** yeb qo'ydim, endi ko'nglim aynayapti.

sentences.text: There are **too many** cars in the city centre in the morning.
sentences.translation: Ertalab shahar markazida mashinalar **haddan tashqari ko'p**.

sentences.text: You put **too much** sugar in my tea — I can't drink it.
sentences.translation: Choyimga **juda ko'p** shakar solib yubordingiz — icholmayman.

sentences.text: We've got **too little** time and **too much** work.
sentences.translation: Vaqtimiz **juda kam**, ishimiz esa **juda ko'p**.

sentences.text: **Too few** people voted in the last election, so the result was disappointing.
sentences.translation: O'tgan saylovda **juda kam** odam ovoz berdi, shuning uchun natija hafsalani pir qildi.

sentences.text: Jasur spends **too much** time on his phone and not enough on his studies.
sentences.translation: Jasur telefonga **juda ko'p** vaqt sarflaydi, darslariga esa yetarlicha emas.

sentences.text: There were **far too many** people in the lift, so we waited for the next one.
sentences.translation: Liftda odam **haddan tashqari ko'p** edi, shuning uchun keyingisini kutdik.

sentences.text: Drinking **too much** coffee can give you a headache.
sentences.translation: **Haddan ortiq** qahva ichish bosh og'rig'iga sabab bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Our team made **too many** mistakes in the second half.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz ikkinchi bo'limda **juda ko'p** xato qildi.

sentences.text: The plants died because they got **too little** water during the summer.
sentences.translation: O'simliklar yozda **juda kam** suv olgani uchun qurib qoldi.

examples.title: **enough** / **too** + **to** + verb
examples.description: too / enough + to + fe'l — nima uchun yetarli yoki ortiqcha: old enough to drive, too late to call.

sentences.text: Madina is **old enough to** drive, but she doesn't want to.
sentences.translation: Madinaning mashina haydashga **yoshi yetadi**, lekin xohlamaydi.

sentences.text: Grandpa is **too** weak **to** walk to the shop on his own.
sentences.translation: Bobom do'kongacha o'zi yurib borishga **juda holsiz**.

sentences.text: We didn't have **enough** money **to** stay in the centre of London.
sentences.translation: London markazida turishga **pulimiz yetmadi**.

sentences.text: It's **too** late **to** call her now — she'll be asleep.
sentences.translation: Unga qo'ng'iroq qilishga **juda kech** — uxlab qolgan bo'lsa kerak.

sentences.text: Are you **brave enough to** try the bungee jump?
sentences.translation: Bunji-jampingdan sakrashga **jur'atingiz yetadimi**?

sentences.text: After the night shift Sarah was **too** exhausted **to** even eat.
sentences.translation: Tungi smenadan keyin Saraning ovqat yeyishga ham **holi qolmagan edi**.

sentences.text: There are **too many** of us **to** fit in one taxi.
sentences.translation: Bitta taksiga sig'ishimiz uchun **juda ko'pmiz**.

sentences.text: The boy was **clever enough to** solve the puzzle in five minutes.
sentences.translation: Bola jumboqni besh daqiqada yecha oladigan **darajada aqlli** edi.

sentences.text: Is the water **warm enough to** swim in?
sentences.translation: Suv cho'milishga **yetarlicha iliqmi**?

sentences.text: Bekzod spoke **too** quietly **to** be heard at the back of the hall.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **juda past** gapirdi — zal oxirida eshitilmadi.

examples.title: **for** somebody **to** do: **too heavy for me to lift**
examples.description: Harakatni kim bajarishini ko'rsatish: too / enough + for + kimdir + to + fe'l. for dan keyin yolg'iz ot ham kelishi mumkin.

sentences.text: The box was **too heavy for me to** lift on my own.
sentences.translation: Quti men yolg'iz ko'tarishim uchun **juda og'ir** edi.

sentences.text: Is this book **easy enough for** a ten-year-old **to** read?
sentences.translation: Bu kitob o'n yoshli bola o'qishi uchun **yetarlicha osonmi**?

sentences.text: The lecture was **too** technical **for** most students **to** follow.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruza ko'pchilik talabalar tushunishi uchun **haddan tashqari** texnik edi.

sentences.text: It's **too** dangerous **for** children **to** play near the river.
sentences.translation: Bolalar daryo yaqinida o'ynashi **juda xavfli**.

sentences.text: Our new flat is **big enough for** all of us **to** live together.
sentences.translation: Yangi kvartiramiz hammamiz birga yashashimiz uchun **yetarlicha katta**.

sentences.text: Prices in that shop are **too** high **for** students.
sentences.translation: U do'kondagi narxlar talabalar uchun **juda** baland.

sentences.text: Is it **warm enough for** a picnic, do you think?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, piknik uchun havo **yetarlicha iliqmi**?

sentences.text: The instructions were **clear enough for** anyone **to** understand.
sentences.translation: Yo'riqnoma har kim tushunadigan **darajada aniq** edi.

sentences.text: That old bridge is **too** narrow **for** two lorries **to** pass each other.
sentences.translation: O'sha eski ko'prik ikkita yuk mashinasi bir-biridan o'tib ketishi uchun **juda tor**.

sentences.text: There wasn't **enough** room **for** everyone **to** sit down.
sentences.translation: Hamma o'tirishi uchun **joy yetmadi**.

examples.title: **too hot to drink**: no object at the end
examples.description: Gapning egasi fe'lning to'ldiruvchisi ham bo'lsa, oxirida it / them qo'yilmaydi: too hot to drink, too heavy for me to carry.

sentences.text: This tea is **too hot to drink** — let it cool down a bit.
sentences.translation: Bu choy ichish uchun **juda issiq** — biroz sovusin.

sentences.text: The suitcase was **too heavy for me to carry**, so Aziz helped.
sentences.translation: Chamadon men ko'tarishim uchun **juda og'ir** edi, shuning uchun Aziz yordam berdi.

sentences.text: His handwriting is **too messy to read**.
sentences.translation: Uning yozuvi **o'qib bo'lmaydigan darajada** chalkash.

sentences.text: The film was **good enough to watch** twice.
sentences.translation: Film ikki marta **ko'rishga arziydi**.

sentences.text: These boots are **too uncomfortable to wear** on long walks.
sentences.translation: Bu etiklar uzoq sayrda **kiyib yurishga juda noqulay**.

sentences.text: Is the river **clean enough to swim** in?
sentences.translation: Daryo **cho'milsa bo'ladigan darajada tozami**?

sentences.text: Sorry, that question is **too difficult for me to answer** right now.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu savol hozir **javob bera oladigan darajada oson emas**.

sentences.text: The chair was **too old to repair**, so we threw it away.
sentences.translation: Stul **ta'mirlab bo'lmaydigan darajada eski** edi, shuning uchun uni tashlab yubordik.

sentences.text: His explanation was **simple enough for a child to understand**.
sentences.translation: Uning tushuntirishi **bola ham tushunadigan darajada sodda** edi.

sentences.text: Kate found the soup **too spicy to eat**, so she ordered a salad.
sentences.translation: Sho'rva Keytga **yeyish uchun juda achchiq** tuyuldi, shuning uchun u salat buyurtma qildi.

examples.title: Mixed: **too** ... or not ... **enough**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: too = not ... enough, too much / many, for somebody to do — kundalik vaziyatlarda.

sentences.text: The trousers are **too** short — they're not **long enough**.
sentences.translation: Shim **kaltalik qiladi** — **yetarlicha uzun** emas.

sentences.text: Jasur isn't **old enough** to vote — he's only seventeen.
sentences.translation: Jasurning ovoz berishga **yoshi yetmaydi** — u endigina o'n yetti yoshda.

sentences.text: We left **too** late, so we didn't get there **early enough** to find a seat.
sentences.translation: Biz **juda kech** chiqdik, shuning uchun joy topadigan **darajada erta** yetib bormadik.

sentences.text: This room is **too** dark — there aren't **enough** windows.
sentences.translation: Bu xona **juda qorong'i** — derazalar **yetarli** emas.

sentences.text: The test was **too** easy; it wasn't **challenging enough** for advanced students.
sentences.translation: Test **juda oson** edi — kuchli talabalar uchun **yetarlicha murakkab** emas edi.

sentences.text: I can't afford it — it's **far too** expensive, and I haven't got **enough** savings.
sentences.translation: Bunga qurbim yetmaydi — u **haddan tashqari** qimmat, **yetarli** jamg'armam ham yo'q.

sentences.text: Is your coffee **sweet enough**, or would you like more sugar?
sentences.translation: Qahvangiz **yetarlicha shirinmi** yoki yana shakar solaymi?

sentences.text: Dilnoza says she's **too** busy **to** meet this week.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bu hafta uchrashishga **juda bandligini** aytyapti.

sentences.text: In summer there are **too many** tourists, so we visit Khiva in October.
sentences.translation: Yozda sayyohlar **haddan tashqari ko'p**, shuning uchun Xivaga oktabrda boramiz.

sentences.text: The hotel was cheap, but it wasn't **clean enough for** us **to** stay more than one night.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona arzon edi, lekin bir kechadan ortiq qolishimiz uchun **yetarlicha toza** emas edi.
